newsitem.title: USA: GranCare has new credit line commitments.
newsitem.headline: GranCare has new credit line commitments.

text.p: GranCare Inc said Wednesday it had received commitments for a $300 million credit facility from First Union National Bank and Chase Manhattan Bank to replace its existing $150 million facility.

The new facility, arranged in connection with the pending merger of GranCare's pharmacy subsidiary, TeamCare, with Vitalink Services Inc, includes a five-year, $100 million term loan and a five-year, $200 million revolver.

On consummation of the merger, proceeds from the new credit line will be used to pay down GranCare debt and redeem its outstanding 6-1/2 percent convertible subordinated debentures due 2003 totaling $60 million.
The redemption of the debentures will occur simultaneously with the closing of the merger.
GranCare also said it will effect a two-for-three reverse stock split, reducing outstanding shares by some eight million.

Earlier in the quarter GranCare sold its interest in Alternative Living Services Inc for a one-time gain of about $19 million. Proceeds from the sale were used to pay down a portion of the company's credit facility.
